change_summary: EXP-582 integrated (queue_id 477, class deep-attack): WIN-005 detail_evidence rewritten to remove the unverifiable 160-200/80-120 nT/yr cell-decay figures (c3 hole #1 MAJOR / ISS-2520) and replace them with a CHAOS-7-grounded three-metric disambiguation; lobe naming standardized to American/South Atlantic vs eastern African (c3 hole #2 MODERATE / ISS-2521); Terra-Nova overstatement softened to match WIN-004; metadata-only monitor.py note added (c3 hole #3); and an advocate-mode preemptive paragraph appended to detail_verdict_text neutralizing the binary-prediction goalpost-moving charge (c3 advocate defense_survives=3).
our_argument_summary: Verdict Std Model Explains: MHD reversed-flux-patch dynamics at the core-mantle boundary reproduce the SAA inter-lobe decay asymmetry; the dome has no fluid core / MHD / geometric derivation and adopts a published, pre-existing CHAOS-7 observation (post-hoc carve-out fails). Post-integration the detail_evidence now disambiguates three distinct decay metrics (minimum-value decline ~28-30->~47 nT/yr, peak local secular variation ~98 nT/yr from CHAOS-7 GVO 492 nT/2014-2019, and the dome one-bit qualitative claim), and detail_verdict_text preemptively rebuts the goalpost-moving defense.

code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: Standard MHD (Terra-Nova et al. 2017, 10.1016/j.pepi.2017.03.002; CHAOS-7 Finlay et al. 2020, 10.1186/s40623-020-01252-9) explains the SAA inter-lobe asymmetry via reversed-flux patches in the outer-core fluid. The dome relabels the same phenomenon as aetheric field geometry with no equations.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: The secondary (eastern/African) minimum emerged since ~2014 and was documented by CHAOS-7 (published 2020); the dome registered PROS-005 in 2026 (per c3). Asymmetry was public CHAOS-7 output years before the dome claim. The integrated advocate paragraph relies on exactly this ordering.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: No formula takes disc_radius/firmament_height as inputs and outputs 23,050/21,880 nT or any decay rate. Values adopted from CHAOS-7; dome supplies no per-lobe quantitative rate at all (the integrated text states this as metric (iii)).

holes_found.description: The three-metric reconciliation that replaces the old MAJOR inconsistency now rests on an asserted, uncited acceleration. detail_evidence reads: the minimum-value drop is ~28-30 nT/yr over recent decades, accelerating to ~47 nT/yr across 2000-2025 ... consistent with the ~28-30 nT/yr multi-decade station figure used in WIN-035 (the same quantity over a faster recent window). Numerically the two figures differ by ~1.6x (46.8/29), so the entire claim that they are the same quantity hinges on the word accelerating. Two problems: (a) the acceleration is asserted with no citation in the published text - the EXP-582 objection-handling cites that CHAOS-7 documents a non-uniform/accelerating SAA decline, but that support lives in the EXP file, not in detail_evidence the reader sees; (b) the windows are labelled imprecisely - 28-30 is tagged over recent decades while 47 is tagged 2000-2025, but 2000-2025 IS recent decades, so a careful reader cannot tell that 28-30 is meant as the longer full-record/station average and 47 as the recent-window rate. This is the same internal-consistency standard on which c3 graded the original 160-200 vs 28-30 gap a MAJOR hole; the fix swaps unverifiable numbers for a reconciliation whose linchpin is itself unsupported in-text.
holes_found.recommendation: Add a short attribution for the acceleration (CHAOS-7 / Finlay et al. 2020 documents that the SAA intensity decline is non-uniform in time and has accelerated, with the fastest decreases in the most recent epoch) and clarify the windows, e.g. ~28-30 nT/yr averaged over the full multi-decade station record, rising to ~47 nT/yr over the 2000-2025 window. This converts the reconciliation from assertion to sourced fact without changing any number.

holes_found.description: Residual cross-WIN dangling end (now on WIN-035, not WIN-005). stronger_arguments.description: The integrated text establishes that the African lobe IS the secondary minimum that emerged since ~2014. A newly-emerging, deepening secondary minimum will by construction show a faster apparent rate of change than the established primary lobe - so the dome predicting that the African lobe decays faster is close to definitionally true for any young deepening feature, making the one-bit claim even more trivial and more clearly post-hoc. This sharpens, not weakens, the Std Model Explains verdict and could be folded into the verdict text in one sentence.
sources: wins.json WIN-005 detail_evidence (eastern African lobe = secondary minimum emerging since ~2014)

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome correctly recognises the SAA two-lobe asymmetric-decay structure and adopts CHAOS-7-consistent intensity values: wins.json WIN-005 detail_evidence cites the 23,050->21,880 nT pair, whose implied 46.8 nT/yr (verified this run: (23050-21880)/25 = 46.80) sits sensibly inside the observed minimum-value decline and is consistent with WIN-035s ~28-30 nT/yr multi-decade figure once the metric/window distinction is applied. Getting the two-lobe structure and the numbers right is non-trivial.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Per wins.json WIN-005 detail_evidence the dome supplies no quantitative per-lobe rate (metric (iii)), no equations, and no derivation from disc_radius/firmament_height (derives_from_dome=false); per the same field the monitor.py pipeline has no WIN-005 domain so the confirmed status is a static inject_ai_layer.py metadata row, not a code comparison (monitoring evidence above); and per detail_verdict_text the asymmetry was public CHAOS-7 output before PROS-005 registration, so the Part 3.1b post-hoc carve-out fails. Adopting a published observation and asserting aetheric geometry explains it is not predicting it.

advocate_mode.best_defense: A defender would still run the goalpost-moving line: you concede the African lobe decays faster, concede the dome identified two lobes, concede the adopted numbers match CHAOS-7 - so the dome made a falsifiable binary prediction that was confirmed, and demanding a numerical rate it never claimed is unfair.
advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: Already substantially neutralized: the integrated detail_verdict_text advocate paragraph concedes the narrow one-bit falsifiability, then defeats it on (i) ~1 bit vs CHAOS-7 continuous per-location constraint and (ii) pre-registration post-hoc failure. Downgraded from defense_survives=3 (c3) to 2. The only remaining sliver is the moderate hole above: if a defender attacks the acceleration as unsupported, they reopen an internal-consistency seam - sourcing the acceleration closes it.

deeper_analysis: EXP-582 is a clean, well-executed integration: it removed numbers c3 could not source, replaced them with a primary-source-grounded three-metric framework, fixed the lobe nomenclature, brought Terra-Nova into line with WIN-004, and preemptively answered the goalpost-moving defense. All three c3 holes (MAJOR ISS-2520, MODERATE ISS-2521, MODERATE metadata-only) are addressed, and the advocate defense drops from 3 to 2. The verdict Std Model Explains survives a fourth look. The one new hole the integration introduces is structural rather than factual: in resolving a MAJOR inconsistency it leaned on an in-text acceleration claim that is itself uncited and imprecisely windowed - the reconciliation is correct (the SAA decline genuinely accelerated and the two windows evidence it) but the published text asserts rather than sources it, which is exactly the kind of seam c3 graded harshly on the original numbers. Sourcing the acceleration and clarifying the windows would make the WIN bulletproof. Two minor items (WIN-035 cross-ref dangle; monitoring tag borderline-none) are logged for the decider but neither is verdict-affecting.
